annotations.title: Five-second test: humans' first impression of an image

description: Real people look at a screenshot for five seconds and say what it is about and whether they would trust it. Done by the community: several anonymous humans answer through the Human Registry app – fast, remote, directional. Every task is reviewed by a human before it goes out. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot; acting for a business: price on request. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

context.description: Optional context shown with the image.

image_url.description: https URL of the image (JPEG, PNG or WebP, max 1.2 MB).

question.description: Optional question instead of 'What is it about – and would you trust it?'
